priorityList: Ensure Devotion Aura, Rite of Sanctification, and Rite of Adjuration are active before combat.
Use Avenging Wrath if Divine Toll is available or will be within 10 seconds.
Cast Divine Toll while Avenging Wrath is active to maximize Holy Power generation.
Cast Sacred Weapon (Holy Armaments) if the buff is missing or has less than 6 seconds remaining.
Spend Holy Power on Shield of the Righteous as your primary spender.
Cast Hammer of Wrath whenever available, especially during Avenging Wrath.
Cast Avenger's Shield if the Vanguard buff is active or during Avenging Wrath.
Use Holy Bulwark (Holy Armaments) if Avenging Wrath is nearly ready (under 5 seconds) or if you have 2 charges.
Cast Consecration if you reach 5 stacks of Divine Guidance.
Cast Judgment if it is about to reach maximum charges to avoid wasting cooldown time.
Cast Avenger's Shield to generate Holy Power and trigger Grand Crusader.
Cast Blessed Hammer (or Hammer of the Righteous) if the Blessed Assurance buff is active.
Cast Judgment as a primary Holy Power generator.
Maintain Consecration on the ground at all times.
Use Word of Glory only when the Shining Light proc makes it free.
